entry.title: Public Access Cable Committee (PACC): the meeting of 8 September 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: PACC will seek a November special town meeting warrant for more money as FY27 salaries run tight. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f1AbB5ZEQ5Q), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
